newsitem.title: USA: Exxon Texas cat cracker unit still down.
newsitem.headline: Exxon Texas cat cracker unit still down.

text.p: Exxon Corp's 110,000-barrel-per-day (bpd) fluid catalytic cracking unit that was downed by lightning Monday night remained out of service Wednesday morning but should be operational soon, the company said.
Exxon did not elaborate, except to say it would announce when it does restore the cat cracker to productivity.
Cat crackers are run on so-called intermediate feedstocks that are lighter than crude oil and churn out lighter refined products, particularly gasoline.
The huge refinery can process a total of 411,000 bpd of crude oil.
